Council beginning at 6:00 p.m. on May 16, 2022 in the Council Chambers at Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk
Boulevard and via videoconference. Speakers at this meeting are limited to speak only on the item listed on the
following agenda:

ROLL CALL  City Clerk

REPORT

FISCAL YEAR 2022/23 PROPOSED BUDGET - The Fiscal Year 2022/23 Proposed Budget is presented for
discussion and direction.

Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on the 12th day of May 2022.

   City Council Agenda Report
  May 16, 2022

TO:  Honorable City Council

FROM:  Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager

BY:  Jana Stuard, Director of Finance/Treasurer

SUBJECT: FISCAL YEAR 2022/23 PROPOSED BUDGET

Background:

Each year the City is required by the Norwalk Municipal Code to prepare an annual budget
and present it to City Council for public consideration. The proposed budget for the
upcoming fiscal year, which covers the period July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023, was
presented to the Finance Ad Hoc Committee on May 5, 2022 and distributed to the
members of City Council on May 9. The document was also made available for public
review in the City Clerk’s Department and on the City’s web page.

The Fiscal Year (FY) 2022/23 Proposed Budget contains the following sections:
   Summaries:
   Changes to Fund Balances/Working Capital
   Inter-Fund Transfers
   All Funds – Expenditure Summary
   All Funds – Full Time and Part Time Hours
   General Fund Revenue Summary
   General Fund Expenditure Summaries by Type and Function
   Revenues – all funds
   Capital Outlays
   Capital Projects – carryover and new projects.
   Departmental Detail – contains the following information for each departmental
  division (Budget Unit):
   Activities and Objectives
   Personnel Information – summarizes budgeted full-time positions and part-
  time hours.
   Activity Detail – contains the explanation and/or the breakdown of certain
  expenditure line items, such as: contract services, membership, special
  studies, special projects, etc.
   Departmental Expenditure Budget – details line items per Budget Unit.
 City Council  May 16, 2022
Fiscal Year 2022/23 Proposed Budget  Page No. 2

The financial plan assumes that the City will resume its normal operations at the pre-
COVID-19 levels. The FY 2022/23 Budget is balanced by using the City’s available
resources, including the newly voter-approved 0.75% additional local sales tax, to
primarily fund public safety enhancements for both the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s
Department and the City’s community policing services implemented by City Council in
the current fiscal year, as well as other operating expenditures. The available General
Fund balance is used to replenish the City’s capital reserves, primarily the Parks
Renovation, Building Renovation, and Street Renovation funds.

Subsequent to City Council direction at this and following budget review meetings, a final
budget will be prepared and submitted for adoption at a public hearing scheduled for a
meeting in June.

Fiscal Impact:

Contingent on City Council’s direction, the proposed budget, when adopted, will serve as
the City’s expenditure plan for a one-year period, covering July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023.

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Plan 2021 Implementation:

The recommended action adheres to the City’s values to be fiscally responsible, ethical
and transparent in City’s stewardship; and it will further the City’s strategic plan goal (3)
Maintain strong local tax base to support City operations.

Recommended Action:

The Fiscal Year 2022/23 Proposed Budget is presented for discussion and direction.
